restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes (one root block, flags 11, length 64, counter 0).
Grouped birthday search: 2^96 groups with shared m0..m14; each group enumerates all 2^32 values of m15.
Digests computed by partial evaluation of the 2-round compression (shared group-invariant G work), not by charging one full compression unit per message.
Collision filter: Briggs-Torczon sparse set keyed by the top 140 digest bits; matches re-verified with two full reference compressions.

Classical 256-bit word RAM with 64 registers. Claimed ledger: inner 252 Word ops (FF = 8 xors, no trailing & MASK) + 14 pack + 21 table = 287 ops/msg; no 14-op spare. Full G still counted at organizer-faithful 30 ops.
Fallbacks disclosed: restore FF & MASK without spare → 295 ops → 127.457; restore spare on 309 ops → 127.524 (package 8e870aed); reload 27 group constants → 314 ops → 127.546.
Success probability 0.39 under score-critical H1-grouped-digests; time/memory caps are worst-case and heuristic-free.
Analytical construction; no full-scale collision certificate.
Independent derivation; does not adopt public 247-op inner body (that undercounts organizer _g=30 as 29 on several segments).
Tightening of awaiting-review 8e870aed (127.524): drop spare + omit redundant FF masks only; algorithm and probability unchanged.

heuristics.statement: For uniformly random independent group prefixes (m0..m14) and exhaustive m15 enumeration, the 2^128 digests behave like independent uniform 256-bit strings for bounding (i) the probability of no full-digest collision among them and (ii) the probability that a colliding pair is missed because an earlier distinct digest occupied the same top-140-bit sparse-set slot, up to a negligible additive gap covered by the allowance between the model bound (>0.3932) and the claimed success probability 0.39.
heuristics.scope: Applies only to this grouped birthday search with N=2^128 messages, sparse-set index of 140 bits, and the stated partial-evaluation digest map. Does not assert differential weakness, rho statistics, or sub-birthday structure.
heuristics.extrapolation: Organizer matched-scale digest-xor-mask experiments at widths 16, 20, and 24 with N_t^2/2^w=1, plus a single-group structured stress layout, are extrapolated to the full 256-bit collision event under H1. The leap crosses about 232-240 untested digest bits. Single-group dependence is disclosed; full-scale uses 2^96 independent prefixes so within-group pairs are a 2^-96 fraction of pair mass.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is not proved. Truncation cannot detect almost-permutation structure. Within-group pairs are more dependent; local non-organizer checks showed lower hit rates in the single-group layout. No full-scale collision is known. Organizer report is authoritative for experiment frequencies.
